meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 signal-cli 设备链接添加 Signal 频道集成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将 Signal 频道集成到你的应用中
copy.tagline_en: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Signal channels into your application

howto.what: 装上后，助手会通过 Signal 收发消息：以你扫码绑定的手机号接收私聊和群聊，支持 Markdown、引用回复、打字提示与 Note to Self；语音消息默认只收到占位符。
howto.when: 完成设备链接、重启服务并完成会话配置后，你在 Signal 里向该号码发私聊或群聊消息时触发；新 Signal 用户首次发消息会被拦截（not_member），需先授权。

say.text: 你好，收到我这条 Signal 消息吗？
say.note: 验证私聊通路是否连通

say.text: 请用 Markdown 加粗回复我。
say.note: 检查 Signal 侧 Markdown 渲染

say.text: 引用我上一条消息回复我。
say.note: 验证 Signal 引用回复支持

howto.what_en: After installation, the assistant can send and receive Signal messages through the linked phone number, including DMs and group chats. It supports Markdown formatting, quoted replies, typing indicators (DMs only), and Note to Self. Voice messages arrive as placeholders unless transcription is added.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you send a DM or group message to the linked Signal number after device linking, service restart, and session wiring are done. New Signal senders are blocked (not_member) until granted access.

say_en.text: Hi, can you hear me on Signal?
say_en.note: Verify the DM channel is connected.

say_en.text: Reply to me with bold Markdown.
Quote my previous message in your reply.
